cards.title: Tidepool Shell Tray
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sequence card for turning a fictional tidepool lab errand into first, next, then, and finally steps: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, set out three small paper shells, and invite the writer to place them in story order: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Use each blank to tell what the tidepool timekeepers do before the shell counter is reset: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the tidepool timekeepers find a shell counter beside ____________________.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, the smallest timekeeper carries ____________________ to the sorting tray.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, the lab note changes because ____________________.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the shell counter is ready when ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Add one sequence word that helps the reader move from one shell step to ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does the first step clearly happen before ____________________?
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number the three shells silently and write only the middle step: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Retell the tiny lab sequence at home with three paper marks: ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Ferry Docks
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sequence card for strengthening the middle of a fictional ferry crossing on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw four small ferry docks, and choose one plain draft sentence to send across: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Build the crossing so the middle events explain how the sentence changes before it lands: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the Revision River ferry leaves the drawer dock carrying ____________________.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, the ferry pauses when the draft sentence notices ____________________.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, the middle dock changes the sentence by adding ____________________.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the ferry reaches the far dock with ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Add a transition phrase that shows the middle turn after ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does the middle event make the final sentence easier to understand: ____________________?
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write only the ferry pause and the changed detail: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Draw three ferry docks and label the strongest middle step: ____________________.

cards.title: Clue Label Tower Trail
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sequence card for ordering invented museum clues from broad label to final detail: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, sketch a tower of four blank labels, and remind the writer that every exhibit is fictional: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Fill the labels so each clue gives the next clue room to make sense: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the lowest tower label names an exhibit shaped like ____________________.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, the second label adds the detail ____________________.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, the third label changes the clue by showing ____________________.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the top label reveals why ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Add a transition phrase that connects the second clue to ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does each clue appear before the clue that depends on ____________________?
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: List the four label details before writing the full trail: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Turn four paper scraps into clue labels and order them around ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Craft Choice Path
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sequence card for linking a fictional compass-making choice to its next results: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw a paper compass dial, and choose one academy craft choice to test: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Show how each choice causes the next academy step inside the pretend academy page: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, the apprentice chooses ____________________ for the compass center.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, that choice causes the compass mark to point toward ____________________.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, the apprentice adjusts ____________________ because the pointer changes.
cards.finallyPrompt: Finally, the finished compass helps the academy find ____________________.
cards.transitionPrompt: Add a cause-and-effect transition such as because, so, or after: ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does each result grow from the choice before it: ____________________?
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw one tiny cause arrow from the first choice to ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Name one cause and one result from your compass story: ____________________.

cards.title: Binding Day Final Thread
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable sequence card for making the last steps of a fictional booklet ending feel complete: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold one scrap page like a tiny booklet, and choose a final paper problem: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the ending steps so the boardwalk booklet closes the problem instead of starting a new one: ____________________.
cards.firstPrompt: First, near the ending, the page keeper gathers ____________________.
cards.nextPrompt: Next, the keeper checks ____________________ before the ribbon is tied.
cards.thenPrompt: Then, the final page shows ____________________ has changed.
cards.transitionPrompt: Add an ending transition that shows the last step follows ____________________.
cards.checkBackPrompt: Check back: Does the final moment answer something from earlier: ____________________?
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Box the detail that feels like closure and write it here: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Stack four scrap pages and name the final sequence: ____________________.
